---
title: "Condition-adjusted MAG associations with cleaning performance"
format: html
editor: source
---

Sensitivity analysis, specified after viewing cycle-adjusted
results. The composite and its frozen reference parameters are unchanged.
For each of 14 fixed candidates, DNA/RNA and Initial/Backflush are separate views:
`lm(score ~ condition + x)`. Six observations, three residual degrees of freedom.
Two-sided OLS t tests, BH across all 56 new slope tests; HC3 t approximations
corrected separately. Also report BH over all 168 tests including the earlier
112 fits, without replacing their saved results. No cycle adjustment: shared
temporal trends can drive these associations. Membrane and condition remain
confounded. Independent Gaussian errors are a working assumption, not a verified
repeated-measures model. Candidate selection and score construction uncertainty
are not accounted for by these nominal p-values and intervals.

DNA x is log2 normalized whole-MAG abundance; RNA x is the all-combined3905-gene
mean centred log2CPM score. No phase pooling, no duplicated outcomes in a fit.
DNA suppression changes are index units, not percent biofilm reduction. This
analysis complements, and does not supplant, cycle-adjusted fits.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(length(out)==1,!is.na(out),!dir.exists(out))
root<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
paths<-c(observations=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_MAG_models_2026-09-14-v1/tables/model_observations.tsv"),
 old_models=file.path(root,"cleaning_score_MAG_models_2026-09-14-v1/tables/models.tsv"),
 score=file.path(root,"cleaning_performance_score_2026-09-14-v1/cleaning_score.rds"))
sha<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
before<-vapply(paths,sha,character(1))
z<-fread(paths['observations'])[specification=="categorical_cycle"]
old<-fread(paths['old_models']);scores<-readRDS(paths['score'])$scores
stopifnot(nrow(z)==336,nrow(old)==112,uniqueN(z$MAG_ID)==14,
 !anyDuplicated(z[,.(MAG_ID,predictor,phase,condition,cycle)]))
check<-merge(z,scores[,.(condition,cycle,canonical_score=score)],by=c("condition","cycle"))
stopifnot(nrow(check)==336,max(abs(check$score-check$canonical_score))<1e-12)
ans<-list();observations<-list();deletions<-list();scenarios<-list();fits<-list()
keys<-unique(z[,.(MAG_ID,predictor,phase)])
for(i in seq_len(nrow(keys))){
 key<-keys[i];d<-copy(z[key,on=.(MAG_ID,predictor,phase)])
 setorder(d,condition,cycle);d[,condition:=factor(condition,levels=c("control","treatment"))]
 fit<-lm(score~condition+x,d);X<-model.matrix(fit);df<-df.residual(fit)
 stopifnot(nrow(d)==6,fit$rank==3,df==3)
 b<-unname(coef(fit)['x']);se<-sqrt(vcov(fit)['x','x']);h<-hatvalues(fit)
 stopifnot(all(h<1-1e-10))
 V<-solve(crossprod(X));hc3<-V%*%crossprod(X,X*as.numeric((resid(fit)/(1-h))^2))%*%V
 se3<-sqrt(hc3['x','x']);rx<-resid(lm(x~condition,d));ry<-resid(lm(score~condition,d))
 stopifnot(abs(b-sum(rx*ry)/sum(rx^2))<1e-9)
 dl<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(cy){
  ff<-lm(score~condition+x,d[cycle!=cy])
  data.table(dropped_cycle=cy,beta=unname(coef(ff)['x']),rank=ff$rank,df=df.residual(ff))
 }))
 stopifnot(all(dl$rank==3),all(dl$df==1))
 dl[,`:=`(MAG_ID=key$MAG_ID,predictor=key$predictor,phase=key$phase,same_sign=sign(beta)==sign(b))]
 deletions[[i]]<-dl
 ans[[i]]<-data.table(specification="condition_only",MAG_ID=key$MAG_ID,genus=d$genus[1],
 predictor=key$predictor,phase=key$phase,n=6,residual_df=df,beta=b,se=se,
 CI_low=b-qt(.975,df)*se,CI_high=b+qt(.975,df)*se,p=2*pt(-abs(b/se),df),
 HC3_se=se3,HC3_p=2*pt(-abs(b/se3),df),
 HC3_low=b-qt(.975,df)*se3,HC3_high=b+qt(.975,df)*se3,
 max_leverage=max(h),max_Cook=max(cooks.distance(fit)),
 predictor_VIF=1/(1-summary(lm(x~condition,d))$r.squared),
 leave_cycle_same_sign=sum(dl$same_sign))
 d[,`:=`(specification="condition_only",fitted=fitted(fit),residual=resid(fit),partial_x=rx,partial_score=ry)]
 observations[[i]]<-d;fits[[paste(key,collapse="/")]]<-fit
 if(key$predictor=="DNA"){
  sc<-data.table(suppression=c(0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95))
  sc[,delta_x:=log2(1-suppression)]
  sc[,`:=`(MAG_ID=key$MAG_ID,genus=d$genus[1],phase=key$phase,
   delta_score=b*delta_x,low=(b+qt(.975,df)*se)*delta_x,high=(b-qt(.975,df)*se)*delta_x)]
  sc[,treated_below_observed_range:=vapply(delta_x,function(dx)sum(d[condition=="treatment",x]+dx<min(d$x)),integer(1))]
  scenarios[[i]]<-sc
  dd<-copy(d);dd[,x:=x-1]
  stopifnot(max(abs(predict(fit,dd)-predict(fit,d)+b))<1e-9)
 }
}
a<-rbindlist(ans);stopifnot(nrow(a)==56)
a[,`:=`(FDR_56=p.adjust(p,"BH",n=56),HC3_FDR_56=p.adjust(HC3_p,"BH",n=56))]
combined<-rbindlist(list(old,a),fill=TRUE)
combined[,`:=`(FDR_168=p.adjust(p,"BH",n=168),HC3_FDR_168=p.adjust(HC3_p,"BH",n=168))]
a<-combined[specification=="condition_only"]
sc<-merge(rbindlist(scenarios),a[predictor=="DNA",.(MAG_ID,phase,p,FDR_56,FDR_168)],by=c("MAG_ID","phase"))
stopifnot(nrow(sc)==196,all(sc[suppression==0,delta_score]==0),all(sc$low<=sc$high),
 identical(before,vapply(paths,sha,character(1))))
dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
fwrite(a,file.path(out,"models.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(combined,file.path(out,"all_specifications.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(rbindlist(observations),file.path(out,"model_observations.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(rbindlist(deletions),file.path(out,"leave_cycle_out.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(sc,file.path(out,"DNA_suppression_scenarios.tsv"),sep="\t")
saveRDS(fits,file.path(out,"fitted_models.rds"))
paths<-c(paths,notebook=Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH"))
fwrite(data.table(path=paths,sha256=vapply(paths,sha,character(1))),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
file.copy(paths['notebook'],file.path(out,basename(paths['notebook'])))
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,"sessionInfo.txt"))
writeLines(c("PASS:56 full-rank six-row fits,3 residual df;unchanged canonical composite.",
 "PASS:FWL slopes,168 cycle-deletion fits,196 DNA scenarios,predict contrasts,source hashes.",
 "Two-sided OLS/HC3 t summaries;BH56 and BH168. Temporal confounding not adjusted."),file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
print(a[,.(tests=.N,nominal=sum(p<.05),BH56=sum(FDR_56<.05),BH168=sum(FDR_168<.05),
 HC3_BH56=sum(HC3_FDR_56<.05),min_p=min(p),min_FDR=min(FDR_56))])
print(a[order(p),.(MAG_ID,genus,predictor,phase,beta,p,FDR_56,HC3_FDR_56,leave_cycle_same_sign)][1:10])
```
